title: 2-[2,6-Bis(4,4′-difluorobenzhydryl)-4-methylphenylimino]-3-aryliminobutylnickel complex precatalysts tuning polyethylene elastomers with different molecular weights
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28601-28612
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04501K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dongzhi Zhu, Qiuyue Zhang, Dedong Jia, Yanping Ma, Wen-Hua Sun
Unsymmetrical 2,3-bis(arylimino)butylnickel complexes exhibited high activity and yielded unimodal polyethylenes with diverse branches and controllable crystallinity from semi-crystalline to nearly amorphous structures.
